newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian 95/96 underlying PSBR A$7.26 bln.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian 95/96 underlying PSBR A$7.26 bln.

text.p: The underlying budget balance for all Australian governments and their enterprises in the fiscal year to June 1996 was A$7.26 billion, up from a deficit of A$6.96 billion in 1994/95, the Australian Bureau of Statistics reported.
General government operations produced an underlying deficit of A$6.42 billion, down from A$7.87 billion previously, and almost entirely attributable to the federal deficit of A$7.75 billion.
The underlying deficit adjusts the cash balance for such capital transactions as asset sales.
Public trading enterprises nationwide yielded an underlying deficit of A$754 million -- again, mostly because of federal enterprises' deficit of A$561 million.

The national consolidated figures are close to international definitions of public sector borrowing requirements, although the adjustment to produce an "underlying" figure reflects recent Australian concern to exclude asset sales from budget data.
